questions.q: According to the video, what decides whether electrons are ejected from a clean metal surface?
questions.why: The script says the color, not the brightness, decides.

questions.q: In the video, Einstein says light comes in packets. What are these packets called?
questions.why: The script states light comes in packets called photons.

questions.q: A metal has a work function of 2 eV and the photon gives 3 eV. What kinetic energy does the electron get?
questions.why: E_k = hf − W = 3 eV − 2 eV = 1 eV.
